quarterly_data.quarter: Equinix press release: CPP Investments and Equinix Complete atNorth Acquisition to (09-02-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Equinix and CPP Investments completed the acquisition of atNorth, a Nordic data center developer and operator whose footprint spans all five Nordic countries with eight operational data centers and sites under development in Sweden, Finland, Norway and Denmark, serving enterprise and hyperscale AI, cloud and HPC customers. Equinix holds a c. 34% stake alongside CPP Investments' c. 51% controlling stake and Partners Group's c. 10%; atNorth continues to operate independently under its own brand. atNorth CEO Eyjolfur Magnus Kristinsson: since the signing atNorth has been 'securing new hyperscale contracts and expanding our development pipeline, including a new site in Norway'. Purchase price and financing terms omitted.
quarterly_data.figure: atNorth: eight operational data centers across five Nordic countries; Equinix stake c. 34%
